svg.desc: ASCII portrait of Hrushikesh M drawn from his photo, beside his facts: exploring agentic AI, then security for AI agents; BCA 2nd year at NIE FGC Mysore; 2nd place at Prayag, a national product development competition; 3rd at Cyber-clash, a state-level hackathon; works in Python, JavaScript, Bash and C++; ThinkPad T430 with CachyOS; 19 years old; open to internships and freelance work.
